data_preparation_worktree.important: network_scenario.py/network_compare.py/scenario cards and latest lake handoff are uncommitted/untracked worktree files; branch commit alone does not include them. No checkout/cherry-pick/write performed.

existing_asset_limits: network-observation/v2 is 1 alert/3 rows: known target 1 hit, other destination/outside window excluded. Its old target aisoc.raw_events must not be reused for current independent next service.
network_compare.py understands legacy retained investigation/observer formats, not current socai2 29-table rows; reuse field/ID/hash comparisons, not its old Run schema or dispatch.

Current C4 host+time+class query does not filter destination: different-destination records inside the host/window are valid context, not exclusions. Current sparse controls therefore use other-host/before-window/at-end, not different-destination.
Upstream generic generator titles/descriptions may embed attack interpretation; not a blind quality benchmark. Use neutral observed-action titles and separate independent oracle.

minimum_three_scenarios.scope: Use sealed repair-k5 two cards unchanged: each 2 alerts/1 incident/1 Case, A0+A1+I+C then narrowly scoped H and second C.
minimum_three_scenarios.hidden_truth: Authorised maintenance is benign; first-round source does not expose authorisation. H confirms A0 task only; does not authorise A1 network or prove completion.

minimum_three_scenarios.scenario: credential attempt with multiple observed stages
minimum_three_scenarios.scope: New card per backend: 2 alerts + 4 lake observations: dump-command start, TCP connect, nearby child-process start, 750000-byte outbound flow. A0+A1+I+one C; no additional H.
minimum_three_scenarios.hidden_truth: Authored malicious credential-access simulation. Command start and PID ancestry do not prove completed dump or network causality; flow counts do not prove exfiltration.

minimum_three_scenarios.scope: New card per backend: 2 alert observations, 3 stored lake controls (other host, before start, exact end), zero matching formal query rows. A0+A1+I+one C.
minimum_three_scenarios.hidden_truth: Behavior/authorisation unknown; exclude from directional-accuracy denominator.
minimum_three_scenarios.tool_expected: process=0/network=0/auth=0; queries may be unrequested, which must remain separate from completed zero-row results.

supplemental_material.state: draft material only; not a dispatch authorization or sealed batch; old k2 and sealed repair-k5 untouched

field_checklist.check: Exactly 8 new canonical alerts, each card one incident with exactly its two declared members; all four incident IDs distinct. Broker receipt is not processing success.

14 source event IDs, one retained source identity each; preserve raw/OCSF bytes, host/time and flow counters. Credential cards each process=2/network=2/auth=0 under [start,end); sparse cards all zero despite 3 stored control rows each. No old aisoc writes.
Canonical IDs differ from external source IDs; no oracle in material; scope/owner/source retain explicit missingness.
Frozen A input material matches publication; I input members and selected A versions match actual same-card publications; failure/unknown kept and not scored as abstention.
One new C per supplemental card, 48000/4model/4Tool/120s unchanged; exact two members and frozen material/A/I versions. Empty source observations must not become scope-complete negatives.

Read actual request/response pairs, named backend, protocol/profile, schema version, validation decision and usage; tool query IDs/tenant/host/window bind exact expected sets. Show not_requested separately; do not add model/Tool calls just to force coverage.

Model conclusion vs system handoff, supported vs uncertain, delivery partial vs complete, and actual current assessment all separate. No assertion that an HTTP200 or rejected result is a successful investigation.

Use real captured DTO/DB-backed response values with export timestamp, source hashes and batch label; preserve null/unknown/failed and original model text, no fabricated completion/current judgment. Snapshot replay in existing page needs no live proxy or writes.

scoring: Directionally wrong benign/malicious classifications only count as reversals. needs_review is acceptable abstention. Unknown-truth sparse cards excluded from accuracy denominators; citations/scope/completion statements judged separately. A1 network must not inherit malicious label merely because its card oracle is malicious.
